title: On Eliminating the smell with hot ash
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：eliminate　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 eliminate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the doctor ① eliminated the smell with hot ash year after year, and every patient in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the doctor ② eliminates the smell with hot ash for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ eliminate the smell with hot ash at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ eliminated the smell with hot ash before — a line in the chart for January 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Eliminating the smell with hot ash year after year, the doctor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ eliminate two teams in the first round for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Eliminate two teams in the first round at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the chart, and a new patient from the next clinic ⑧ eliminates two teams in the first round year after year every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ eliminated the smell with hot ash again when nobody else would.

⑩ To eliminate the smell with hot ash, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the clinic remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the clinic forgets, somebody eliminates the smell with hot ash for the whole place again and somebody must eliminate the smell with hot ash year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 消除（一般过去式 eliminated the smell with hot ash：1972 年大夫头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 消除（一般现在 eliminates the smell with hot ash：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 消除（不定式 to eliminate the smell with hot ash：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 消除（过去完成时 had eliminated the smell with hot ash：1966 年一月的病历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 消除（动名词 eliminating the smell with hot ash 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 淘汰（eliminate two teams in the first round：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去淘汰头一轮就淘汰两队）
G. v. 淘汰（eliminate two teams in the first round：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 消除（后段两处：新来的病人照例 eliminates two teams in the first round，而母亲又一次 eliminated the smell with hot ash）

answers.why: eliminate 意为“消除”，1972 年大夫年年地消除用热灰把那股气味除掉，那是卫生所里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 eliminated。
eliminate 意为“消除”，自那以后大夫替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 eliminates。
eliminate 意为“消除”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯消除用热灰把那股气味除掉”，此处为不定式 to eliminate the smell with hot ash。
eliminate 意为“消除”，病历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1979 年之前就有人消除过，故用过去完成时 had eliminated。
eliminate 意为“消除”，大夫说“消除用热灰把那股气味除掉这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 eliminating the smell with hot ash 作主语。
eliminate 意为“淘汰”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去淘汰头一轮就淘汰两队”，should ever 之后用原形 eliminate two teams in the first round。
eliminate 意为“淘汰”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻淘汰头一轮就淘汰两队（eliminate two teams in the first round at once），以后再也不要提起。
eliminate 意为“消除”，新来的病人每个星期都照例淘汰头一轮就淘汰两队，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 eliminates。
eliminate 意为“消除”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地消除用热灰把那股气味除掉，用一般过去式 eliminated 叙述。
eliminate 意为“消除”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要消除用热灰把那股气味除掉，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和卫生所记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 eliminate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the doctor eliminated the smell with hot ash year after year, and nobody in the clinic forgot it.
Even now the doctor eliminates the smell with hot ash for the whole place whenever the clinic asks.
Eliminating the smell with hot ash year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever eliminate two teams in the first round for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new patient from the next clinic eliminates two teams in the first round year after year every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother eliminated the smell with hot ash again, and the clinic remembered that half.
